title: Long-Distance Movers in Anaheim | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Anaheim long distance movers for out-of-state households: one dedicated truck, one flat rate and a loading plan built around your street and your building.
heroSubtitle: One dedicated truck, one crew and one flat price from your Anaheim curb to the new state

faq.question: Do you charge by the hour for a move out of Anaheim?
faq.answer: An interstate move is quoted flat-rate for the whole truck, so a slow loading day in a condo garage does not change the figure. Hourly rates belong to local work and are not applied here. The quote covers fuel, mileage and road taxes as well as the crew.

faq.question: How early should an Anaheim pickup be booked?
faq.answer: As soon as the destination address is settled. Buildings here often want a certificate of insurance and a booked lift, and a Parking Variance from the Traffic Engineering Division is not issued the same morning. A $50 deposit holds the date, and same-day pickups are possible when a crew and a truck are free within our Monday - Sunday, 8AM - 6PM hours.

faq.question: Can the truck park outside my house on a street sweeping day?
faq.answer: Only on the side that is not being swept in that window. Neighbourhood sweeping runs Monday through Thursday, mornings 8 a.m. to noon and afternoons noon to 4 p.m., and the sweeper can arrive at any point inside it. Where a "No Parking for Street Sweeping" sign is posted a citation follows California Vehicle Code 22507.6, so we read the signs on your block first.

faq.question: How long will delivery take once the truck leaves Anaheim?
faq.answer: It depends on the route, so we quote a window rather than a date, from a few days upward. Nothing else travels on that truck, which means the schedule is not affected by anyone else's shipment. The coordinator calls ahead before the crew arrives.

faq.question: What happens if the new home is not ready when the truck gets there?
faq.answer: Tell the coordinator as early as you can. If the gap is a single night, your things stay loaded and secured for $200 and the crew delivers the next day. For a longer wait the load goes into storage in transit, priced before the truck leaves Anaheim rather than improvised at the far end.

faq.question: Are you licensed to move a household across state lines?
faq.answer: Yes: USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, with CAL-T0192140 for work that stays inside California. All three are public records. Ask any mover for the first two numbers before you pay a deposit, and check them against the federal register.
